about_short_description.short_description: Houm is an end-to-end solution that helps property owners to rent and sell their residential properties up to 10x faster.

product.name: Houm Marketplace
product.description: An online platform for property owners to list residential properties for rent or sale and for users to search and transact these properties.

product.name: Property Management Service
product.description: A service that manages rental properties on behalf of owners, including tenant selection, rent collection, and maintenance coordination.

product.name: Rental Guarantee Plans
product.description: Insurance-like plans that guarantee rental income to property owners even if tenants delay or default on payments, with varying coverage durations and protections.

product.name: Online Property Listing and Promotion
product.description: A service to publish property listings with professional photography and promote them across major real estate portals to reach potential renters or buyers.

product.name: Digital Contract Signing and Documentation
product.description: A fully digital process for signing rental or sale contracts and submitting required documentation online to streamline transactions.

product.name: Mortgage Credit Simulator
product.description: An online tool that calculates mortgage financing options based on property value, down payment, term, and interest rates.
